error-boundary.$description: ErrorBoundary's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--error-boundary-<name>) on the page, a container or one boundary. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. The fallback itself is an Alert: use the --alert-* tokens for its colors.

focus-ring.$description: The ring when the fallback takes focus.

radius.$description: The fallback box's corners, matching the Alert (8px).
